$comment: Optional convenience templates for the connection form. These are pure data: they only
prefill a JDBC URL prefix and a driver class name so users do not have to memorise them.
Nothing in the extension branches on database type - a template is not a dialect.
Users can override this file by placing their own copy at
so a user entry with the same id replaces the built-in one.
`jdbcUrlTemplate` mirrors the connection form fields. `{host}` `{port}` `{database}` and
`{properties}` are substituted with what the user typed; anything else is left literal.

templates.label: Custom
templates.description: Type the JDBC URL and driver class yourself.

templates.label: openGauss / GaussDB
templates.note: Some GaussDB builds only accept the PostgreSQL-flavoured driver entry point; if the class above is not found, try org.postgresql.Driver with the same URL.
